I am an **Adjunct Professor** at the Federal University of Pampa (UNIPAMPA), currently on leave (*afastada*) while working at CADE. My teaching has covered macroeconomics, labor economics, game theory, and public finance for undergraduate Economics students.

## Courses taught

- Macroeconomics I, II, and III
- Labor Economics (*Economia do Trabalho*)
- Game Theory (*Teoria dos Jogos*)
- Public Finance (*Finanças Públicas*)
